items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: Okay, we’re going to play Beethoven Fifth.

ctx.x: I do. [scats] So that’s what I hear. Because that’s what this represents. That’s why they teach solfeggio. They teach solfeggio because it bypasses visual. It’s not visual. It’s music — if you’re looking for music to make sound, all you do is you crumble it up and put it in your fireplace and you can hear it burn. Really. ‘Cause it doesn’t exist. This is a shortcut for people to play together or to practice certain things that people think are important. And that’s all. Otherwise it’d be like, “Okay, we’re going…
They taught them how to rehearse.
